name: Vehicle Grade and Weight
summary: Shows a vehicle's total weight and the grade it's on, next to the speed in the vehicle window.
description: Adds two readouts next to the speed under the camera view in the vehicle window. Weight: the vehicle's total weight, empty weight plus the passengers and cargo on board; hover it for the split. Grade: the average slope under the whole vehicle, in percent, + when climbing and - when descending. Works for trains, trams, buses and trucks; ship, aircraft and person windows are unchanged. The readouts hide while the vehicle is at a stop. Cosmetic: achievements stay enabled.
